subject.title: feat(mac): native pairing approval dialog with instant decisions

question: Should macOS pairing cards disappear immediately before the gateway confirms the trust decision, with reconciliation and failure restoration providing the authoritative correction path?
rationale: Tests can validate state transitions, but maintainer intent is required to accept this feedback tradeoff on a trust-sensitive pairing surface.

options.title: Approve optimistic dismissal after fixes
options.body: Accept immediate card dismissal once localization is fixed and native proof demonstrates successful completion and failure restoration.

options.title: Keep cards until confirmation
options.body: Retain each request until the gateway responds and improve progress feedback rather than presenting an optimistic resolution.

recommendation.title: Approve optimistic dismissal after fixes
recommendation.body: Accept immediate card dismissal once localization is fixed and native proof demonstrates successful completion and failure restoration.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history ties this person to the current macOS pairing panel and its recent UX direction.
